title: UI & Visual Designer Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to master visual design fundamentals, advanced tooling, and professional workflow. Build a showcase portfolio and prepare for senior‑level roles.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Solidify visual fundamentals and basic design thinking.

milestones.title: Typography Basics
milestones.outcome: Select and pair typefaces confidently for any UI.

tasks.title: Read typography chapter
tasks.description: Study the typography section on MDN to understand font families, weights, and line‑height.

tasks.title: Create type hierarchy chart
tasks.description: Design a hierarchy for headings, body, and captions in a single page using Figma.

tasks.title: Apply hierarchy to mock screen
tasks.description: Replace placeholder text on a sample app screen with your typographic hierarchy.

tasks.title: Reflect on readability
tasks.description: Write a short note on how spacing and size affect readability.

milestones.title: Colour & Layout Principles
milestones.outcome: Develop balanced layouts and accessible colour palettes.

tasks.title: Study colour accessibility guide
tasks.description: Read the WCAG colour contrast guide on WebAIM and note contrast ratios.

tasks.title: Build a colour palette
tasks.description: Create a 5‑color palette in Figma that meets AA contrast for text.

tasks.title: Design a grid system
tasks.description: Set up a 12‑column grid in a new Figma file and place sample cards.

tasks.title: Prototype a layout
tasks.description: Arrange three UI screens using the grid and palette, then preview in Figma.

tasks.title: Connect with a design community
tasks.description: Share your palette on a design forum and ask for feedback.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Become proficient with industry tools and systematic design.

milestones.title: Master Figma Basics
milestones.outcome: Navigate, prototype, and collaborate efficiently in Figma.

tasks.title: Complete Figma fundamentals tutorial
tasks.description: Follow the free Figma official tutorial covering frames, components, and constraints.

tasks.title: Build a component library
tasks.description: Create reusable button, input, and card components with variants.

tasks.title: Practice auto‑layout
tasks.description: Re‑create a login form using auto‑layout to test responsiveness.

tasks.title: Reflect on collaboration features
tasks.description: Note how sharing and commenting improve teamwork.

tasks.title: Connect with a Figma community
tasks.description: Join a Figma Discord channel and introduce yourself.

milestones.title: Design Systems Foundations
milestones.outcome: Define and document a cohesive design system.

tasks.title: Read design system guide
tasks.description: Study the free design system handbook from Material Design.

tasks.title: Create style guide page
tasks.description: Document typography, colour, and spacing tokens in Figma.

tasks.title: Assemble component set
tasks.description: Add the previously built button and card components to the system.

tasks.title: Practice versioning
tasks.description: Duplicate the file, make a minor update, and note version changes.

tasks.title: Reflect on consistency
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how the system improves UI consistency.

milestones.title: Prototyping & Motion Basics
milestones.outcome: Create interactive and animated UI prototypes.

tasks.title: Watch prototyping basics video
tasks.description: View the free Figma prototyping tutorial on YouTube.

tasks.title: Add interactions to screens
tasks.description: Link three mock screens with tap and hover triggers in Figma prototype mode.

tasks.title: Create a simple motion animation
tasks.description: Animate a button hover using Figma’s Smart Animate feature.

tasks.title: Test prototype on device
tasks.description: Open the prototype on a phone and note any usability issues.

tasks.title: Reflect on motion purpose
tasks.description: Write why motion improves user feedback in this prototype.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Produce portfolio‑ready projects that showcase depth.

milestones.title: Design System Project
milestones.outcome: A complete, documented design system ready for portfolio display.

tasks.title: Plan system scope
tasks.description: Outline the components, tokens, and pages you will include (minimum 8 components).

tasks.title: Build component library
tasks.description: Create all components in Figma with variants and constraints.

tasks.title: Document usage guidelines
tasks.description: Write brief notes for each component on when and how to use them.

tasks.title: Create a showcase page
tasks.description: Design a single page that presents the system with examples and code snippets.

tasks.title: Reflect on system gaps
tasks.description: Identify any missing elements and plan next improvements.

milestones.title: Polished App Screens
milestones.outcome: Three high‑fidelity app screens demonstrating visual polish and consistency.

tasks.title: Select an app concept
tasks.description: Choose a simple app idea (e.g., habit tracker) and sketch user flow.

tasks.title: Design high‑fidelity screens
tasks.description: Create three screens in Figma using your design system components.

tasks.title: Add micro‑interactions
tasks.description: Apply hover and transition animations to key UI elements.

tasks.title: Export assets for handoff
tasks.description: Generate PNG/SVG assets and organize them in a folder.

tasks.title: Connect with a peer reviewer
tasks.description: Send the screens to a fellow designer for critique and note feedback.

milestones.title: Motion Prototype
milestones.outcome: A short motion prototype illustrating an interactive UI transition.

tasks.title: Define interaction scenario
tasks.description: Pick a single interaction (e.g., onboarding swipe) to animate.

tasks.title: Create frames for each state
tasks.description: Design the start, middle, and end states in Figma.

tasks.title: Apply Smart Animate
tasks.description: Link frames with Smart Animate and fine‑tune easing curves.

tasks.title: Record prototype video
tasks.description: Export a GIF or MP4 of the animation for portfolio use.

tasks.title: Reflect on motion impact
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how the motion improves user understanding.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish professional habits, advanced topics, and job readiness.

milestones.title: Advanced Handoff Practices
milestones.outcome: Deliver design specs that engineers can implement without ambiguity.

tasks.title: Study handoff guidelines
tasks.description: Read the free handoff best‑practice article on the Figma blog.

tasks.title: Create annotated specs
tasks.description: Add measurements, constraints, and notes to a screen for developers.

tasks.title: Export design tokens
tasks.description: Generate a JSON file of colours, spacing, and typography from Figma.

tasks.title: Mock a developer review
tasks.description: Walk through the specs with a colleague acting as an engineer and answer questions.

tasks.title: Reflect on communication gaps
tasks.description: Document any misunderstandings and how to prevent them.

milestones.title: Professional Portfolio & Presence
milestones.outcome: A polished online portfolio and personal brand ready for recruiters.

tasks.title: Choose a portfolio platform
tasks.description: Select a free site builder (e.g., Behance or Dribbble) and set up a profile.

tasks.title: Write case studies
tasks.description: Draft concise write‑ups for each project, focusing on problem, process, and outcome.

tasks.title: Add high‑quality visuals
tasks.description: Export and upload images and motion GIFs from your projects.

tasks.title: Gather testimonials
tasks.description: Ask a former client or teammate for a short endorsement.

tasks.title: Reflect on personal narrative
tasks.description: Summarize your design philosophy in 2‑3 sentences for the about page.

milestones.title: Interview & Freelance Prep
milestones.outcome: Confidently discuss work, solve design challenges, and win contracts.

tasks.title: Review common interview questions
tasks.description: Read a free UI design interview guide on freeCodeCamp and note key answers.

tasks.title: Practice a design challenge
tasks.description: Complete a timed 1‑hour UI redesign exercise and record your process.

tasks.title: Create a rate sheet
tasks.description: Research market rates and draft a simple freelance pricing table.

tasks.title: Network with recruiters
tasks.description: Send a brief intro message to 3 design recruiters on LinkedIn.

tasks.title: Reflect on strengths and gaps
tasks.description: Write a short self‑assessment to guide future learning.
